# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b15 - Device controls and source-selector fixes

This opt-in beta fixes the live issues reported after the rooms-first setup release. The requested public setup sequence remains rooms, each room's six source/device selections, General settings, and Finish. Home/room/controller identities remain unchanged. Stable v0.5.1 and all previously published beta tags are untouched.

## Change control method on the device, not in Configure

On a selected native climate, fan or humidifier/dehumidifier controller, choose **Automatic, Manual, Off or PID where supported** directly. Automatic/PID no longer sends you back to the removed commissioning form. Explicit method selection authorizes only that controller's selected native sources and current feedback configuration; it does not enable the old room-wide drivers or neighboring devices.

Ordinary native setpoint/speed regulation and physical power/mode switching remain distinct. The controller device now has **Allow power and HVAC mode control** for equipment that supports OFF, plus minimum ON/OFF and maximum-run settings. Enable that switch deliberately for on/off operation or native HVAC-mode changes; this is on the device page, not another configuration wizard. Raw relay/proportional hardware still needs its existing independently verified hardware configuration. Selecting a method never directly sends a hardware command.

The controller also exposes its occupancy requirement, sleep behavior, and applicable fan purpose/verified-feedback settings. Current sources, ownership, fresh feedback and interlocks are rechecked before dispatch. A running manual appliance is not silently adopted for automatic power control. Revoking power permission drains an owned output only after its required minimum runtime. Changing source membership, feedback or physical identity requires explicit method reselection; old grants cannot revive by removing and re-adding equipment. Foreign-entry ownership and pending commands remain protected.

## Fix read-only Home Assistant options writes

Home Assistant exposes config-entry options as a read-only mapping. The shared writers now make a recursive mutable copy rather than trying to pickle that mapping. This fixes `cannot pickle 'mappingproxy' object` for room Sleep/ISO 7730 switches and other Home/room/device settings that use these writers. Nested saved data is not modified in place.

The **ISO 7730 / PMV** preference can be enabled before every scientific input is ready. It does not invent a comfort result: missing or invalid radiant temperature, air speed, clothing and activity inputs continue to produce unavailable/incomplete diagnostics. The room device now offers radiant-temperature and air-speed source selectors restricted to the selected room inputs; existing MET, CLO and air-speed value controls stay on the room device. Do not substitute ordinary air temperature for measured radiant temperature without an appropriate measurement model.

## Template room lists are selectable

Room-list template sensors are offered even when their current state is empty or temporarily unavailable. State or a relevant attribute can be selected. This includes a count-state sensor with a `rooms` attribute, such as `sensor.multi_room_presence`, and comma-separated room names in `sensor.sleeprooms` or similar templates.

Runtime parsing supports lists, JSON, bounded Python/Jinja list literals, room-to-boolean/count mappings, and comma/semicolon/newline-separated names. Room IDs and actual area names are resolved conservatively. A fresh explicitly empty list means no listed rooms; unavailable, stale or invalid data remains unknown, not "nobody home". Selecting a source does not remove that runtime validation.

## Selector captions

Entity choices use **Device name - Entity name (state)**, with a normal ASCII hyphen. Empty parts, empty state parentheses and duplicated device prefixes are omitted. A nonempty zero remains visible. Entity IDs are used only as the last-resort name when no human-readable name exists; the stored value remains the exact entity ID. All 38 catalogs retain their existing localized controls with the additional device fields.

## Verification and install

Publication requires Python 3.13/3.14 regressions, deterministic translations, compilation and dashboard checks, HACS, Hassfest, plus isolated checks using installed Home Assistant 2026.10.0. Those include actual read-only config options, the reported switches, direct method selection, template selectors and room/device registry migration. No user's live installation or physical equipment is operated by these checks.

Update through HACS with beta versions visible, select **v0.6.0b15**, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser. Keep the existing integration entry. Reopen the managed controller to choose its method. For power/on-off operation, review its device-page permission and timing settings. Existing equipment safety requirements and independent physical protections remain applicable.

The manual installation ZIP and SHA-256 checksum are attached. This is a prerelease and is not marked stable Latest.
